description: Surface observations from Desert Rock and Penn State test whether air temperature and humidity explain downward thermal radiation. Competing equations separate blackbody emission from effective sky emissivity; clouds and vertical structure remain unresolved.

assumptions: Near-surface temperature proxies the radiating atmosphere
Effective emissivity is constant across all retained conditions; clouds are unresolved
equation_templates.name: Gray-atmosphere emission

nodes.meaning: Blackbody longwave irradiance at the measured near-surface temperature
Atmospheric longwave irradiance under an effective gray emissivity

emissivity.meaning: Effective sky emissivity, conditional on sampled conditions

assumptions: Brutsaert-inspired clear-sky family evaluated on all retained weather conditions
Humidity is derived from simultaneous temperature and relative humidity using the documented saturation-vapor formula
Clouds and vertical profiles are omitted; transfer failure is retained
Sourced constitutive prior, not an independently discovered radiation law
equation_templates.name: Humidity-modulated sky emission

nodes.meaning: Blackbody longwave irradiance at the measured near-surface temperature
Longwave irradiance from the emissivity-temperature decomposition

amplitude.meaning: Effective emissivity scale at the normalization point

exponent.meaning: Humidity response exponent in a Brutsaert-inspired family

preprocessing: Require QC=0 for target, temperature and RH
scientific_scope: Local scientific-method development; no independent-discovery claim
split_policy: Train: Desert Rock January; development: Desert Rock July; test: all retained Penn State January/July days. Whole site-day blocks remain together.

stability.domain: Observed training ranges; positive physical quantities
stability.scope: Diagnostic input sensitivity; no calibrated measurement-error model

title: Atmospheric longwave radiation across climates

variable_descriptions.target: Measured downward longwave irradiance from the pyrgeometer
variable_descriptions.temperature: Measured near-surface air temperature, converted to Kelvin
variable_descriptions.vapor_pressure: Derived water-vapor partial pressure from simultaneous relative humidity and air temperature; Tetens approximation
